description: A .NET library for authenticated symmetric encryption, envelope encryption, key wrapping, and Azure Key Vault-backed key protection.
rules: Prefer SecureEncryptor with an IKeyEncryptor for application payload encryption.
Use EncryptionKey.CreateDefault for new symmetric keys; it currently creates AES-256-GCM keys.
Use DeveloperKeyEncryptor only for local development because its master key is stored in cleartext.
Prefer Azure Key Vault or another external KEK provider for production key protection.
Treat legacy AES-CBC APIs as compatibility-only and do not use them for new data.
